note: Publisher-owned pointer list: which board task ids this Cell publishes, and where their notices and specs live. This file cannot claim a task is open. scripts/publish_open_tasks.py resolves every entry against Base (stage, deadlines, commit/reveal counts) and writes the result into open-tasks.json. An entry whose chain read fails is published as chain-unreadable-do-not-trust-this-page, never as open.

tasks.settle_note: Keeper-called settleConsensusOnChain after the reveal window closed with zero commits and zero reveals: the budget was refunded to the requester and the task moved to Refunded. Permissionless - any address could have called it.
